external_entities.name: calling service
external_entities.description: A backend operated by another product team that calls the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: The description also refers to these as 'two of the calling services'.

external_entities.name: ML engineer
external_entities.description: An ML engineer who publishes model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests from other teams' backends and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: The description says, 'I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket.'

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.
data_stores.notes: The description says, 'I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket.'

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features such as account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The features include account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response written for debugging, including raw prompts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging.
data_stores.notes: Raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call gateway
data_flows.description: A calling service sends an inference request to the inference gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
data_flows.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header. Keys are issued per calling team and we have never expired one.
data_flows.data_description: Inference requests and an API key

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The inference gateway forwards an inference request to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account for access.

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password on it; it is only reachable inside the model network.
data_flows.data_description: Customer features including account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.name: write log
data_flows.description: The inference gateway writes each request and response to the inference log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_flows.notes: Raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: publish artifacts
data_flows.description: An ML engineer publishes new model artifacts to the model registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.notes: The description says, 'I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account.'

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the model server and Redis feature store, intended to be reachable only from the inference gateway.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
trust_boundaries.notes: The model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway.

trust_boundaries.name: different cloud
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud location where two of the calling services operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: two of the calling services are in a different cloud

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a FastAPI service, and FastAPI is a web application framework.

assumptions.assumption: The customer features in the Redis feature store are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The store contains account age and spend bands per customer, which are customer-specific personal information.
